text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I-I won...! In the Arima Kinen... me...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Um, you know what...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I could hear them. Everyone's voices 
cheering me on!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sounds unbelievable, right? But it's true!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Usually, all I can hear is the beating of 
my heart, my own breathing, and the sound 
of the wind, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Today... I clearly heard a voice. It was 
shouting, "Go for it, Nei-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I was able to push through 
even when my stamina was spent. It was 
so... so much fun!"

For Nice Nature, who shares a deep bond 
with those who support her, this Arima 
Kinen seems to have become a truly special 
race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I want to run again. Next year... on this 
very stage!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, you dummy!Isn't it way too early 
for that!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Because it really felt so good... *mumble*

Targeting next year's Arima Kinen from 
this early on might indeed be setting the 
goal a bit too far ahead.

If we were to slot in a race in between to 
maintain this current motivation...
choice_data_list:
We've got the Takarazuka Kinen coming up 
too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen... That's the race 
where contenders are chosen by fan vote, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Just like the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Turning cheers into strength... I never 
thought I'd be the one saying something 
like that, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It seems like races like that make me 
stronger. Yeah, the Takarazuka Kinen... I 
want to enter!

"Even so, that goal is still a bit further 
down the line. We decided to grow toward 
the Takarazuka Kinen while running various 
other races along the way."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Are the two of us being way too impatient? 
Deciding on the next race right here and 
now, like—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text: Nei-chaaan! You did greaaat!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text:
You're the greatest Umamusume in the 
world! You're our pride and joy!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, e-everyone...! You're being way too 
loud, this isn't a store!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, saying 'best in the world' is 
totally overdoing it! Gosh, that's so 
embarrassing!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Geez... hehe.
choice_data_list: It's okay to just be happy right now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I told you, that's the hardest part for 
me! Like you don't already know that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“Still, right now... you know? Yeah, 
that's right.”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right now... I have to properly celebrate. 
It's not like everything is completely 
over yet.

Nice Nature murmured, her eyes drifting 
toward the fellow Umamusume who had run 
the Arima Kinen with her...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...The 'wobbly trophy.' Did you prepare 
one for me today too?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Thank you. Well then... debrief 
first, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"—Looking back at how I used to be... 
Honestly, I wasn't really paying attention 
to what was around me."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was so focused on the gap between me and 
Teio that I forgot there are other rivals 
out there too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Running out there today really drove it 
home. If I let my guard down for even a 
second, I definitely would have lost.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I might be able to win right now, but... 
Everyone around me is going to keep 
getting stronger from here on."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I can't go on like this. This is no time 
to be talking about beating Teio."

For better or worse, Nice Nature had spent 
all this time watching nothing but Tokai 
Teio, who ran far ahead at the front of 
their generation.

However, running in the Arima Kinen 
alongside many different generations seems 
to have broadened your horizons. ...A true 
sign of growth!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I need to know. More about everyone around 
me...!

—On the way home. That opportunity arrived 
sooner than expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! Come join me for a post-race 
debrief after this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. Well then, let us find a 
place—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No need for that! Let's head back and talk 
while doing muscle training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Right now!? Th-That's a bit...!

Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan. Though 
they had competed against Nice Nature 
today, they appeared so calm you wouldn't 
think they had just finished a race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Those two...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait here for a moment, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'll be right back...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh? Nature-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for earlier. I have firmly taken 
note of your strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you were super strong! Great work to 
both of us!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, there's something I wanted to ask you 
two!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering... how both of you... 
can stay so strong.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...You might think it's not like me to 
ask something like this, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, those two, how should I put it... 
feel like they truly stand on their own 
two feet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what an interesting thing to say. 
On your own two feet... huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What do you want to do, McQueen? You're 
much better at this sort of thing than me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Honestly, there you go again...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well, then. If you truly wish to 
know, I shall enlighten you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah! Really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, I have no intention of explaining 
every single little detail to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall show you something far more 
certain than mere words. I am sure that 
will be more than enough for you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Come hang out anytime!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"If that's what you want, I'm more than 
ready to whip you into shape!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Ryan's training is truly grueling, so 
please prepare yourself."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well then, farewell. —Until next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, McQueen! For our review meeting, the 
gym is fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That idea is rejected!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Something certain...? What does that 
mean...

—Leaving a strong anticipation of newfound 
growth, her Classic Year challenge came to 
a close.
